name: Critical Corruption Error
storyline: Deleted is trapped in a corrupted dimension filled with portals to other worlds. While exploring this strange place, he encounters something unusual; upon clicking it, he is transported to the menu of Trash Coin. However, when he clicks on the skins, Deleted ends up becoming a skin within the Trash Coin game.
summary: It is an unlisted, mysterious game where you control a Deleted character from *Trash Coin*—a character that is already corrupted. The creator posted the link on their website and YouTube community tab. The game features an aesthetic of errors, corruption, and glitches, and includes portals leading to all of the creator's other games on the platform; there is a portal to a fan-made game and another one labeled in the files as "Portal new corrupteds dimensions." and the game has a hidden secret ending that connects to the game Trash Coin
